purpose: Uniform random extension of the two prior U18 45-post corpora to a combined 100 unique posts.

selection.database: Production PostgreSQL via Render CLI routed over SSH through fuchitalee; read-only query.
selection.window_definition: posts.created_at >= sampled_at - interval 24 hours AND posts.created_at <= sampled_at
selection.eligibility: Nonempty posts.text; created_at within the DB-clock window; at least one row in posts_brands_signals; not in the prior 90-case corpus.
selection.sampling_method: PostgreSQL ORDER BY random() LIMIT 10 over eligible distinct posts (posts is keyed by tweet_id); selected brand is independently uniform among each selected post’s signal-backed brands. No stratification by language, role, brand, or label.
selection.returned_order: Preserved exactly as PostgreSQL sample_order 1 through 10; case IDs assigned in that order.

), eligible AS (
 SELECT p.tweet_id
 FROM posts p CROSS JOIN db_clock c
 WHERE p.created_at >= c.sampled_at - interval '24 hours' AND p.created_at <= c.sampled_at
   AND p.text IS NOT NULL AND btrim(p.text) <> ''
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM excluded e WHERE e.tweet_id=p.tweet_id)
   AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM posts_brands_signals s WHERE s.post_id=p.tweet_id)
), picked_random AS (
 SELECT e.tweet_id FROM eligible e ORDER BY random() LIMIT 10
), picked AS (
 SELECT tweet_id, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY random()) AS sample_order FROM picked_random
), selected AS (
 SELECT p.*, c.sampled_at, x.sample_order, target.brand_id AS target_brand
 FROM picked x JOIN posts p USING (tweet_id) CROSS JOIN db_clock c
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT s.brand_id FROM posts_brands_signals s WHERE s.post_id=p.tweet_id ORDER BY random() LIMIT 1) target
)
